verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service documents scanning and uploading mail to cloud storage, email alerts, and a postcard notice. Nothing in the evidence describes forwarding physical originals, a documented forwarding policy, or how certified mail and checks are handled. Digital scanning is an adjacent feature and does not deliver delivery of the originals themselves.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, original documents are forwarded under a documented policy, so certified mail and checks reach the company
